answer.rationale: The establishment has 300 employees (250+), triggering electronic submission of Form 300A under §1904.41(a)(1)(ii); the 20-249 employee/listed-industry requirement (OSHA-REC-026) does not apply due to employee count exceeding 249. Annual summary creation, certification, and posting obligations under §1904.32 apply regardless of size. Retention obligations under §1904.33(a) apply on an always-on basis. Incident recording requirements are not directly implicated by this year-end scenario absent a specific incident.
